mapper.select: SELECT Ic_Code AS icCode, RTRIM(Ic_Name) AS icName, Ic_Buser AS icBuser, Bs_Name AS ccBuser, Af_FileName AS afFilename, Af_Content AS afContent, Ic_Jikgub AS icJikgub, dbo.GetJikgubNm(Ic_Jikgub) AS icJikgubNm, CASE WHEN ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '1' -- 간호사/간호조무사 WHEN ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) IN (25,26,27) THEN '2' -- 조리사 WHEN ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) = 1 THEN '7' -- 의사 WHEN ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) NOT IN (1,3,4,17,19,25,26,27) AND ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) <> '110' AND ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '9' -- 일반직군 ELSE '0' END AS flag FROM P_InsaCode LEFT JOIN P_InsaDetail ON Id_Code = Ic_Code AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = Ic_Saflag AND Id_Date1 = ( SELECT MAX(Id_Date1) FROM P_InsaDetail WHERE Id_Code = Ic_Code AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = Ic_Saflag AND Id_Date1 <= GETDATE() ) LEFT JOIN P_Buser ON Bs_Code = Id_Job LEFT JOIN P_Jikgub ON Jg_Code = Id_Amount LEFT JOIN P_JikChek ON Jc_Code = Id_FamName LEFT JOIN File_DB.dbo.i_addFile ON Ic_Code = Af_Num WHERE Ic_Code = #{loginId} AND (dbo.GetPwChk(#{loginId},#{loginPw},'Mob') = 'OK' OR #{loginPw} = 'rkskekfk12');

SELECT Ic_Code AS icCode, RTRIM(Ic_Name) AS icName, Ic_Buser AS icBuser, Bs_Name AS ccBuser, Af_FileName AS afFilename, Af_Content AS afContent, Ic_Jikgub AS icJikgub, dbo.GetJikgubNm(Ic_Jikgub) AS icJikgubNm, CASE WHEN ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '1' WHEN ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) IN (25,26,27) THEN '2' WHEN ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) = 1 THEN '7' WHEN ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) NOT IN (1,3,4,17,19,25,26,27) AND ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) <> '110' AND ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '9' ELSE '0' END AS flag FROM P_InsaCode LEFT JOIN P_InsaDetail ON Id_Code = Ic_Code AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = Ic_Saflag AND Id_Date1 = ( SELECT MAX(Id_Date1) FROM P_InsaDetail WHERE Id_Code = Ic_Code AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = Ic_Saflag AND Id_Date1 <= GETDATE() ) LEFT JOIN P_Buser ON Bs_Code = Id_Job LEFT JOIN P_Jikgub ON Jg_Code = Id_Amount LEFT JOIN P_JikChek ON Jc_Code = Id_FamName LEFT JOIN File_DB.dbo.i_addFile ON Ic_Code = Af_Num WHERE Ic_Code = #{loginId} AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),Getdate(),120) BETWEEN ic_InDate AND ISNULL(Ic_Outdate,'2099-12-31') AND ic_Saflag = 1 AND Ic_Code NOT IN ('9620')
